name: bulletproof-sequence
description: F6 on public code: three tasks in a row on the same copy, each building on the code of the sessions before, with no review fix in between, so a missed rule can be copied from the agent's own earlier code. Buried prose against rules + pointer + loop, on bulletproof-react with the same docs, rules and checkers as bulletproof-notify-querykey (arms, plugin and ESLint config are symlinks to it).

tasks.prompt: In apps/react-vite, let the author of a comment edit it: add an update-comment API (PATCH /comments/{commentId} with the new body) and an Edit button with a form drawer in the comments list, shown only on the current user's own comments. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins change a user's role from the users list: add an update-user-role API (PATCH /users/{userId}/role with the new role) and a role select in each row of the users table. The list must show the new role after the change, and a success message should appear. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins rename their team: add an update-team API (PATCH /teams/{teamId} with the new name) and, on the profile page, a Team section that shows the current user's team name with a Rename button (admins only) that opens a form drawer. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.
